Title: Watched It is live!
Content:
# WatchedIt is now live.

WatchedIt is now here, discover new films, find the latest project by your favourite actor, and much more.

Features include

- Track your watched films
.- Like, rate and review films.
- Various ways to search and discover films or people.
- Create lists.
- See other users and what they like.
- Much more.

Title: Kauhu Entertainment presents
Content:
# Kauhu Entertainment presents... freight night coming soon.
Horror film aficionados Kauhu Entertainment is back with a 5 night run at the Teatteri theater with 'Kauhu Entertainment presents... freight night' from October 27th. Watch back to back to back to back horror all night long.
 Doors: 6pm
 Film 1: 7pm
 Interval: 9:30pm
 Film 2: 10pm
 Interval: Midnight
 Film 3: 0:30am
 Interval: 3am
 Film 4: 3:30am
 End: 6am.
